label: Configurator: tilapia + basil DWC raft, 100 m2 grow area, Netherlands greenhouse
_how_to_edit: Pick one component id per category from data/catalog/components_v0.json (region must match). Change the target, labour regime or any value under the *_overrides blocks. Every value you add yourself is your own assumption: note where it came from.

build._location: Wage and electricity come from data/scenarios/unit_configuration_candidates_v0.json (locations block).
build._structure_area_basis: planning_area_m2_uvi_ratio (grow area x UVI land ratio) or minimum_area_m2 (grow area + equipment footprint).
